verdict.rationale: Retell documents a concurrency configuration feature (reserved inbound concurrency vs. outbound limit) showing platform-level concurrency controls exist, but there is no documented default/numeric concurrency limits per plan, no described self-service process to raise limits without contacting support, and no evidence (docs or community) confirming scaling to many simultaneous calls happens without manual requests. missing for 10: published default concurrency limits, self-service limit-increase mechanism, and independent confirmation of large-scale concurrent call handling without support intervention.
